name: Trigger Area
description: An invisible area that knows who is standing in it. Name it, scale it with the gizmo, then have a script react to that name.

drivenBy.rule: The area only publishes who is standing in it — a Script reacts to its name through './runtime/zoneBus', on this item or on any other entity in the scene.
drivenBy.next: Use the Add a reaction button below and the new Script arrives already listening to this area.

changelog.notes: Initial release: an invisible named area that publishes who is standing in it, so a Script anywhere in the scene reacts to it by name with nothing wired.
The placed area's Script card now shows the onZone line a Script reacts with, under its area settings.
